info.text:
How we build a YouTube video in three days or less, from our real files. Alex approves every step.
See our work: https://ka-performancefl.com/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10-16-2

This is how our first long video, "Test your website with one key", was made:

1. The plan. The topic, the page it links to, the playlist and a three-day schedule. Alex approves it before anything is made.
2. The brief and the script. What the viewer gets, the hook, and a script written for the ear.
3. The voice. It's AI narrated, one file per beat, and every take is checked word for word against the script.
4. The captures. Every good example is our own site. Every bad one is a plain test page we built for the video.
5. The edit. Style frames first, then the cut, with our logo and web address on every frame.
6. The approval. Alex watches the finished video, answers the open questions and approves it on our Post Desk. Only then is it scheduled.

Full walkthrough on our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@KAPerformancefl

Want help with your own website? Call Alex at 904-210-1071 or message us here.

The voice in the video is AI narrated. The music is AI generated.

#GainesvilleFL #SmallBusiness #BehindTheScenes
